_comment: Artifact-type registry for the Visual Studio workflow. Downloaded through DownloadTemplate (template_name: datasets/visual_types.json) with an empty template_vars, so this file must contain no doubled-curly-brace placeholder anywhere, not even in a comment. It declares how each type is authored, rendered and formatted; the workflow routes on these fields and adding a type is a data change. Static-raster art direction is NOT here: it stays in datasets/image_motifs.json, and the raster prompt only receives the spec this registry's authoring stage produces.
_comment_author: author is one of: raster (article -> image prompt -> image model), spec_raster (article -> content spec -> raster prompt -> image model), spec_markup (article -> content spec -> deterministic markup from template).
_comment_render: render is one of: static (one raster file), animated (browser frame capture -> img2webp animated webp, gif fallback via GraphicsMagick), text (authored markup committed as-is, never rasterized).
_comment_markers: Each requested type also emits a matching article marker whose syntax is owned by the article workflow; the studio only returns content, never a path or a reference.
_comment_budget: budget.fps/frames/viewport are the animation ceiling. A type may override them lower; the renderer never exceeds the registry value. 12 fps, 36 frames (3 s), 1200 px viewport.
_comment_default: Requested types come from the article entry's ASSET_TYPES (comma-separated). When it is blank, default_types is used. max_types_per_article caps the review loop.
